title: Saudi Arabian Kebabs with Cabbage Slaw
description: A flavorful and spicy kebab recipe paired with a refreshing cabbage slaw, inspired by the street food of Saudi Arabia. This dish is perfect for a quick dinner or snack.

ingredients.name: Saudi Arabian kebabs
ingredients.notes: available in most middle eastern grocery stores

ingredients.name: Arabian spices
ingredients.notes: mix of cumin, coriander, cinnamon, and turmeric

instructions: Thread Saudi Arabian kebabs onto skewers.
In a small bowl, mix together Arabian spices, lemon juice, and garlic.
Brush the spice mixture onto the kebabs.
Grill kebabs for 8-10 minutes, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, shred the Chinese cabbage and mix with parsley.
Drizzle zesty tahini sauce over the cabbage slaw, if using.
Serve kebabs with cabbage slaw on the side.
